# Production-Ready Multi-Vendor Commerce Database

## Objective
Design, implement, test, secure, optimize and document a marketplace data layer.

## Assumptions
- Use synthetic data and a local/disposable PostgreSQL 18.x database.
- Do not commit credentials, connection strings or database dumps.

## Data model and keys

## Security / performance / recovery

## Cleanup and limitations

required_features: stock, carts, orders, payments, returns and refunds
stretch_features: Add a reproducible migration/rebuild from an empty database.
Benchmark one query with a documented test dataset and plan.
Add a failure/recovery walkthrough suitable for the project scope.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver a reviewed relational design and reproducible test plan, preserve transactional order/inventory integrity, restrict tenant data, document query-plan decisions and demonstrate recovery readiness.
Include schema DDL and synthetic seed data.
Include at least five validation queries or automated checks.
Document version assumptions, security boundaries, recovery and cleanup.
test_plan: Create an empty disposable database and run the schema from scratch.
Load a small deterministic synthetic dataset.
Run normal-case queries and edge-case tests for NULLs, duplicates or invalid references.
Run permission checks as the actual restricted role.
For performance/operations scope, capture measured results and avoid invented metrics.
review_method: Human review of schema design, correctness of SQL, test outputs, safety/security choices and maintainability. CodeLeaf does not create databases or run SQL from project submissions.
status_note: Project brief adapted from Section D of the attached PostgreSQL curriculum. This is a project specification, not an executed or certified solution.
